title: Provision Nutanix AHV VM
description: Provisions a Nutanix AHV VM by cloning an approved pre-hardened template, attaching a vNIC, configuring guest customization, creating OS and data disks, assigning security zones and site, powering on, waiting for guest readiness, installing NGT, capturing a pre-CIS hardening checkpoint, and collecting provisioning evidence.

playbook_input.description: Parameters the caller provides before execution

parameters.name: nutanix_host
parameters.description: Prism Central hostname or IP address.

parameters.name: nutanix_username
parameters.description: Prism Central username.

parameters.name: nutanix_password
parameters.description: Prism Central password.

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: Whether to validate SSL certificates (true/false).

parameters.name: os_family
parameters.description: Target OS family: windows or rhel.

parameters.name: approved_template_name
parameters.description: Name of the approved pre-hardened template VM to clone.

parameters.name: new_vm_name
parameters.description: Name for the new VM.

parameters.name: cpu_sockets
parameters.description: Number of vCPU sockets.

parameters.name: cpu_cores_per_socket
parameters.description: Number of cores per socket.

parameters.name: cpu_threads_per_core
parameters.description: Number of threads per core.

parameters.name: memory_size_bytes
parameters.description: Memory size in bytes.

parameters.name: temp_provisioning_port_group_name
parameters.description: Name of the temp provisioning Port Group (subnet) for the vNIC.

parameters.name: new_user
parameters.description: Username for the new guest user.

parameters.name: new_password
parameters.description: Password for the new guest user.

parameters.name: os_disk_size_bytes
parameters.description: Size of the OS disk in bytes.

parameters.name: data_disk_size_bytes
parameters.description: Size of the data disk in bytes.

parameters.name: data_disk_storage_container_name
parameters.description: Name of the storage container for the data disk.

parameters.name: security_zone_names
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of security zone (category) names to assign.

parameters.name: site_name
parameters.description: Name of the site (cluster) where the VM will be provisioned.

parameters.name: checkpoint_name
parameters.description: Name for the pre-CIS hardening checkpoint.

playbook_output.description: Emits new_vm_name, cloned_vm_ext_id, cloned_vm_ip, checkpoint_name, evidence, and all_succeeded.

fields.name: cloned_vm_ext_id
fields.description: External ID of the cloned VM.

fields.name: cloned_vm_ip
fields.description: IP address of the provisioned VM.

fields.name: checkpoint_name
fields.description: Name of the pre-CIS hardening checkpoint.

fields.name: evidence
fields.description: Consolidated provisioning evidence from all steps.

steps.name: Resolve template VM UUID by name
steps.function: Look up the approved pre-hardened template VM UUID by its name.

steps.name: Resolve provisioning subnet UUID by name
steps.function: Look up the temp provisioning Port Group subnet UUID by its name.

steps.name: Is the OS family Windows?
steps.function: Branch on the selected OS family to choose the guest customization payload, NGT capabilities, and readiness port.

steps.name: Build Windows guest customization, NGT capabilities, and readiness port
steps.function: Build the Windows sysprep/unattend guest customization payload with DHCP NIC, hostname, new user, password, and privilege; set NGT capabilities to VSS_SNAPSHOT; set readiness port to 3389.

computations._guest_customization: Build a sysprep/unattend guest customization dict with DHCP NIC, hostname set to new_vm_name, new user, password, and administrator privilege.
computations._ngt_capabilities: Set NGT capabilities to VSS_SNAPSHOT for Windows.
computations._readiness_port: Set readiness port to 3389 for Windows.

steps.name: Build RHEL guest customization, NGT capabilities, and readiness port
steps.function: Build the RHEL cloud-init guest customization payload with DHCP NIC, hostname, new user, password, and privilege; set NGT capabilities to SELF_SERVICE_RESTORE; set readiness port to 22.

computations._guest_customization: Build a cloud-init guest customization dict with DHCP NIC, hostname set to new_vm_name, new user, password, and sudo privilege.
computations._ngt_capabilities: Set NGT capabilities to SELF_SERVICE_RESTORE for RHEL.
computations._readiness_port: Set readiness port to 22 for RHEL.

steps.name: Resolve storage container UUID by name
steps.function: Look up the data disk storage container UUID by its name.

steps.name: Prepare clone parameters
steps.function: Assemble the clone parameters including the resolved template UUID, provisioning subnet UUID, guest customization, and hardware sizing.

computations._clone_params: Assemble a dict with ext_id, name, num_sockets, num_cores_per_socket, num_threads_per_core, memory_size_bytes, nics (one NIC with subnet ext_id from _provisioning_subnet_ext_id, vlan_mode ACCESS, connected), and guest_customization from _guest_customization.

steps.name: Clone template with NIC and guest customization
steps.function: Clone the approved template VM with CPU/RAM sizing, one vNIC on the provisioning subnet, and the OS-specific guest customization.

steps.name: Create OS and data disks
steps.function: Create or resize the OS disk and create the data disk on the cloned VM using the resolved storage container.

steps.name: Resolve security zone category UUIDs by name
steps.function: Look up the security zone category UUIDs by name.

steps.name: Resolve site cluster UUID by name
steps.function: Look up the site cluster UUID by its name.

steps.name: Assign security zones and site to VM
steps.function: Apply the resolved security zone categories and site cluster to the cloned VM.

steps.name: Power on VM
steps.function: Power on the cloned VM and wait for the power task to complete.

steps.name: Wait for guest OS readiness
steps.function: Wait until the guest OS is reachable on the OS-appropriate port.

steps.name: Get VM IP
steps.function: Retrieve the IP address of the powered-on VM after guest readiness is confirmed.

steps.name: Install Nutanix Guest Tools
steps.function: Install and enable Nutanix Guest Tools with OS-appropriate capabilities.

steps.name: Create pre-CIS hardening checkpoint
steps.function: Create a Nutanix recovery point checkpoint for the VM before CIS hardening.

steps.name: Capture provisioning evidence
steps.function: Consolidate provisioning evidence from all collected results into a single evidence string.

computations._evidence: Combine new_vm_name, _cloned_vm_ext_id, _cloned_vm_ip, _os_disk_ext_id, _data_disk_ext_id, _ngt_result, and _checkpoint_result into a single evidence string.
computations._all_succeeded: True if all provisioning steps completed without failure, false otherwise.

steps.name: Emit result block
steps.function: Print the Required Output Format <result> block on success.

steps.name: Emit error and fail
steps.function: Reached via the playbook's rescue block on any task failure. Prints the Required Error Output Format block and fails the play.

phases.name: Pre-checks
phases.description: Resolve template, subnet, and storage container names to UUIDs and prepare OS-specific guest customization, NGT capabilities, and readiness port.

phases.name: Main action
phases.description: Clone the VM, create OS and data disks, resolve security zones and site, assign categories and site, and power on.

phases.name: Post-checks
phases.description: Wait for guest readiness, retrieve the VM IP, install Nutanix Guest Tools, create the checkpoint, and capture evidence.

phases.name: Reporting
phases.description: Emit the structured final result to the caller.

phases.name: Error handling
phases.description: Reached when any step fails; records failure and halts execution.
